assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The payer states precertification was not obtained before services were rendered.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness is coded as R42.
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The monitoring was billed under CPT 93229.
The medical necessity of the monitoring is supported.
